resolved_blockers.detail: User replaced CLAUDE_API_KEY in .env with a workspace-scoped key. Confirmed working via models.list and messages.create. claude-haiku-5-5 confirmed as the real, current model id.
resolved_blockers.thinking_api_note: claude-haiku-5-5 does not support the older `thinking: {type: enabled, budget_tokens: N}` form (400 error directing to `thinking.type.adaptive` + `output_config.effort`). Measured on 20 real MCQ questions: with NO thinking param at all, the model still engaged adaptive thinking on its own (thinking_tokens were NOT 0) -- true 'off' required the explicit `thinking: {type: disabled}` value (confirmed thinking_tokens=0 across the real 20-question sample). 'On' uses `thinking: {type: adaptive}, output_config: {effort: high}`.

scope_changes.change: Gemini free-tier answerers (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, thinking on/off) dropped per explicit user instruction after ~15 minutes of runtime.
scope_changes.reason: Free tier enforces a ~5 requests/minute per-model quota (confirmed via live 429 responses during the cost-projection test and the full run), making the full 1005-question x 2-model x 2-setting sweep take an estimated ~7 hours. User said not to use Gemini given that runtime. All Gemini code (scripts/05b_run_gemini.py) and partial progress were kept for the record but partial result files were deleted so the final report does not include incomplete Gemini data.
scope_changes.when: 2026-10-16, after ~4-20 questions had been answered per Gemini setting
